excerpt: 5 Smart Ways to Turn a Layoff Into Your Next Big Career Opportunity Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Layoffs are dominating headlines. Amazon plans to cut 14,000 corporate jobs, UPS has slashed 48,000 roles, and even household names like Target and Paramount are reducing their teams. If you have been impacted, you are not alone. Tens of thousands of professionals face this reality every week. But here is the truth: a layoff does not have to be the end of your career story. It can be the beginning
